title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. AWARD a five-year firm-fixed-price contract, Contract No. OP136051000, to Merak North America LLC for the…
text:
[Metro Board file 2024-1142, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:  

A.	AWARD a five-year firm-fixed-price contract, Contract No. OP136051000, to Merak North America LLC for the overhaul of 487 HVAC assemblies for the P3010 Light Rail Vehicle (LRV) fleet in the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $10,275,213.00, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any; and
 
B.	ESTABLISH a Life of Project (LOP) budget of $82,562,929 for the P3010 Component Overhaul tasks - Phase 2.
summary: Metro would award Merak North America a five-year contract of up to about $10.3 million to overhaul 487 HVAC units on its P3010 light rail vehicles, and set an $82.6 million budget for the phase 2 component overhaul work.
